headline: Austin robotaxi fleet begins nighttime unsupervised operations for the first time — service previously restricted to daylight hours (ending mid-afternoon); night ops expansion materially widens Tesla's Operational Design Domain; Dallas and Houston had supported evening unsupervised runs since April launch; confirms neural-net vision stack handling low-light, headlight glare, and reduced pedestrian contrast without human intervention

Unsupervised robotaxi fleet surpasses 30 vehicles across Texas — Sunday set single-day record with 7 new unsupervised Model Ys spotted (Austin + Dallas + Houston); fleet growth accelerating as Android app launch expands rider access; each new unit tracked by unique plate via RtaxiTracker community

Tesla Cybercab displayed inside glass box at Miami F1 Grand Prix — 'Autonomy Pop-Up' at Lummus Park ran Apr 29–May 3; Cybertruck towed Cybercab through beachfront crowd marked 'Future is Autonomous'; Miami is confirmed 1H 2026 robotaxi expansion city; follows Optimus appearances at Boston Marathon finish line (Apr 19–20) and Miami Design District (Dec 2025)

Tesla Semi total cost of ownership analysis: $0.08/mile operating cost vs $0.38/mile diesel — Big F Transport orders 40 units citing Scope 3 emissions targets and WAIRE point incentives; Electrek TCO breakdown confirms Semi achieves breakeven vs diesel within 3–4 years at current electricity rates; enterprise fleet adoption accelerating alongside production ramp at Giga Nevada

Netherlands RDW formally submits EU-wide FSD approval application — regulator moves beyond national greenlight to seek harmonized EU authorization; individual EU member states can still approve independently in parallel; analysts cite EU subscriber ramp as catalyst investors are underpricing; full continental rollout gating on FSD v15 but supervised access expanding now

FSD v14.3.2 update (build 2026.2.9.10) rolling out fleet-wide — new RL training stage improves wide variety of driving scenarios; vision encoder upgraded for rare and low-visibility conditions; MLIR compiler rewrite delivers 20% faster reaction time; updated FSD disengagement feedback menu; mitigated lane biasing and tailgating behaviors; 6.8% of fleet already running the build

Tariff and tax credit expiry eliminates 12+ EV competitors from US market — Hyundai, Kia, BMW, Volvo, Honda all pulling or pausing models due to 25% import tariff + $7,500 federal credit expiration; Tesla benefits as the only EV maker with full US domestic manufacturing scale; competitive moat widening by default as foreign brands retreat

First Tesla Semi rolls off high-volume production line at Giga Nevada — 'First Semi off high volume line' posted to X by Tesla; all-electric long-haul truck targeting 500-mile range; marks third major production ramp active simultaneously (Cybercab at Giga Texas, Semi at Giga Nevada, Optimus at Fremont); large-scale manufacturing now officially underway for multiple new product lines
